# geo-hex-toolkit

> Pure Python hierarchical hexagon grid on an equal-area projection with exact integer parent and child links, great-circle distances and polygon cover Python package `trysac-geo-hex-toolkit`, import name `geo_hex_toolkit`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
